item.tib: gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las lho shar dmu yi btsun mdos
item.coloph: ces gsas mkhar rin po che spyi spungs kyi nang nas/ a dkar theg pa chen po'i grol phug(phugs) gsas mkhar gsang ba sgo dgu'i sgrub pa las/ lho shar dmu yi btsun mdos 'di yang / 'chi med yum sras gsum gyi lung don/ gshen chen gsang ba 'dus pa'i thugs bcud/ dbal gshen stag la nyid kyis mdzad srol/ bla chen dran pa nam mkha'i brnags pa/ stang chen dmu tsha gyer med kyi smar byang / mkhas pa de nyid kyis byang phyogs gsang ba'i brag la sgrub (grub) pa bsnyes nas/ bka' ni gsang ba'i brag la sbas so/ man ngag ni thugs la gab bo/ phyis su rten 'brel skabs su babs pa'i kho bo bdag la dngos grub babs pa 'di yang / mtshan ldan bla ma rin po che'i gsung gis bskul ba dang / dad ldan grogs po rnams kyis bskul ba la brten nas/ 7sprul sku blo ldan snying po'i rjes 'bring / 7tshe dbang bde chen snying po'am 7g.yung drung thogs med rtsal du 'bod pa des dkar chag yi ger btab pa'o//
